comparison.objective: Transfer a datum height with a water level and mark a distant post without spilling; candidate installs a rack rail level across posts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fluid-level positioning, hose management, and marking versus rigid rail support, spring-latch insertion, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Accurate transferred mark, no spill or taut hose, and tools returned versus equal rack-unit attachment, full latch retention, and screws.
comparison.reason: Although both span two posts and involve leveling, one measures height through fluid equilibrium while the other performs load-bearing mechanical installation.
